releaseNotes:
• Fixed Android app closure: added full BackHandler for gestures, modals, and remote session
• Zero-allocation inBitmap frame decode eliminating 250 MB/s GC memory churn
• Global unhandled exception recovery & largeHeap enabled in manifest
• Real-time relative release timing badges (e.g. Updated recently • 1 hour ago)
• Persistent DesktopCaptureSession with GDI handle reuse and 60 FPS adaptive backpressure
• Screen fill default display scaling (zero black bars) with 1-tap HUD scaling toggle
